# Jam Weddings

> Wedding photography and cinematography in Malta by a creative team of three.

## Website
- [Home](https://jam.mt/): Jam Weddings photography and wedding films.
- [About](https://jam.mt/#about): Meet the team.
- [Portfolio](https://jam.mt/#portfolio): Wedding photographs and a wedding film.
- [Services](https://jam.mt/#services): Wedding packages, pre- and post-wedding photography, photo booth, cinematography and drone coverage. Consult the current package artwork for prices and conditions.
- [Contact](https://jam.mt/#contact): Wedding enquiries.
